evidence.reason: At the current tip the test still uses dirtying_switch to mutate state/queue.json immediately after the real switch returns. That post-switch mutation causes run.run() to fail post-switch verification and raise the rollback-disabled RecoveryRequired before the health callback can run; the test never asserts the callback was invoked, so it does not exercise the health failure named by the test. This is a test-correctness defect, not a new requirement.
